summary_1line: The Pandavas renounce their kingdom, journey north toward heaven, companions fall for hidden flaws, and Yudhishthira proves supreme righteousness by refusing to abandon a loyal dog.

image_candidates.scene_text: The five Pandavas and Draupadi, dressed in bark garments, depart Hastinapura on foot with a single dog following behind them.
High in the barren mountains, Draupadi collapses onto the earth as the brothers continue their silent ascent toward Meru.
Indra’s radiant chariot descends from the sky while Yudhishthira stands beside a faithful dog, refusing heaven unless the animal may come.
